# MPC-RV

> MPC-RV is a free, open-source MPC-HC-style video player for Linux: an unofficial rewrite of Media Player Classic - Home Cinema (MPC-HC) in Rust, with GTK4 for the interface and mpv for playback. It is not made by the MPC-HC developers. License: GPL-3.0-or-later. Maintainer: Riflan Ahmed.

MPC-HC is a Windows program; on Linux it only runs through Wine. MPC-RV is a native Linux app that rebuilds MPC-HC's menus, default keyboard shortcuts and tools. It plays almost any format FFmpeg decodes (MKV, MP4, AVI, WebM, MOV, TS; H.264, HEVC, VP9, AV1) plus network streams.

Features: MPC-HC's default shortcuts, all remappable; a playlist that opens and saves .mpcpl, M3U, PLS and ASX and plays CUE sheets; subtitle styling, delay and the Subresync bar; volume boost up to +300%, normalization, downmix and crossfeed; zoom, pan & scan, rotation and all 22 MPC-HC shaders; DVD and Blu-ray folders and ISO images (titles, no disc menus yet); audio CDs; capture devices; DVB TV (experimental); MPRIS media keys; 42 languages.

Install: a Flatpak for any distribution from the GitHub releases. An AUR package and a .deb are coming; a native Windows version is in development.
